subject: React Native Developer (AT&T) – Plano, TX – Aaron Ramirez (C2C)
body:
Hello,

I saw your LinkedIn post for the React Native Developer positions (AT&T, Plano, TX, hybrid) and would like to be considered. My tailored resume is attached; LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/aaronsoftware.

- 10+ years in software engineering, 6+ years building cross-platform iOS and Android apps in React Native with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript for Walmart Global Tech (store apps used by 500K+ daily associates), IBM/AEP, and HCSC.
- State management with Redux and Context API, mobile architecture and lifecycle management, RESTful API integration, native Swift / Kotlin module integration, performance optimization, and App Store / Google Play deployments with phased rollouts.
- Mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Expo EAS) and automated testing with Jest and Detox; enterprise-scale delivery with code reviews and cross-functional teams.
- Based in the Dallas area, so the Plano hybrid schedule works for me.

Available on C2C. Glad to discuss rate and start date this week.

Best regards,
Aaron David Ramírez Lezama
